fields.summary: When a derelict research platform surfaces in the Halcyon shipping lane, a retired salvage pilot is hired to find what its crew left behind. What she brings back is worth more than the platform itself, and someone else wants it first.
fields.tagline: Some things are lost for a reason.
fields.title: Halcyon

fields.summary: A survey crew on the edge of charted space finds a signal repeating from a region the maps call empty. Following it means leaving the one thing they promised to protect.
fields.title: Deep Field

fields.summary: A harbour town's oldest secret surfaces when the water drops lower than anyone has seen it. A tired detective has one tide to find out who stands to lose the most.
fields.tagline: The sea gives back what it wants to.
fields.title: Low Tide

fields.summary: A strong swimmer helps a stranger out of the surf and finds herself pulled into a missing-persons case with no body and too many witnesses.
fields.title: Undertow

fields.summary: Three generations of glassblowers fight to keep their furnace lit as developers close in on the old waterfront. A single commission may save the family or finish it.
fields.title: Glass Harbour

fields.summary: A weather-station crew winters at the top of the world and learns their supply drops are being intercepted by someone who knows their names.
fields.title: Cold Meridian

fields.summary: On the final ferry of the night, a ticket inspector counts one passenger too many. Somewhere between the two shores, the extra face begins to look familiar.
fields.title: Night Ferry

fields.summary: Decades after a failed colony mission, its only survivor receives a transmission from the future she never reached. Answering it will cost her the quiet life she built.
fields.title: Afterglow

fields.summary: Two siblings spending a summer at their grandfather's boatyard discover a hand-drawn chart hidden in the hull of an unfinished sloop.
fields.tagline: Adventure comes in on the tide.
fields.title: Tidewater

fields.summary: A young lamplighter's apprentice climbs the hill nobody returns from to relight the last lantern before the festival of the longest night.
fields.title: Lantern Hill

fields.summary: When a second sun appears over the northern hemisphere, a disgraced astronomer is the only person who knows how long the world has left to decide what to do about it.
fields.tagline: One sky. Two suns. No time.
fields.title: Second Sun

fields.summary: A river guide agrees to take a group of strangers through the flooded canyons on a route she swore she would never run again.
fields.title: Blackwater

fields.summary: The caretaker of a decommissioned freight station keeps its engines humming for a convoy that stopped coming twenty years ago, until one night a light appears on the line.
fields.title: Quiet Engines

fields.summary: After a shipyard collapse, a union foreman and a corporate fixer are locked into the same impossible week: raise the last ship or lose the town.
fields.title: Iron Coast

fields.summary: A hospice nurse returns to the seaside town she left at eighteen to care for the one person she has never forgiven.
fields.title: Halcyon Bay

fields.summary: A mild-mannered chess instructor is mistaken for a legendary hustler and has exactly one evening to pull off the con everyone expects.
fields.title: Hal's Gambit

fields.summary: A shy fox who only comes out at dusk befriends a moon-watcher and sets out to find the other half of the sky.
fields.tagline: Half the world. Twice the wonder.
fields.title: Halfmoon

fields.summary: A failing travelling theatre has one night to impress a critic who has already written the review.
fields.tagline: The funniest night of their lives.
fields.title: Paper Moons

fields.summary: Four old friends rent a lake house for one last weekend and discover the owner has left a few house rules.
fields.title: The Long Weekend

fields.title: Ember & Ash

fields.summary: A teenager broadcasts a pirate station from the roof of her apartment block and accidentally becomes the voice of the neighbourhood.

fields.summary: A mountain rescue team races a blizzard to light a chain of signal fires across a pass that has been closed for a century.

fields.title: Velvet Static

fields.summary: A small-town power cut during the biggest aurora of the decade turns a quiet community dinner into an all-night farce.

fields.title: Moth Season
